title: The Sixteenth Prom
author: Odile Ishikawa
blurb: Ulyana Iversen, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
